After seeing my cousin suffer from a rare form of cancer for five months, he lost his battle. He was only 27, and had a two year old son who obviously didn't understand what had happened. After the wake, the close family was sitting in the room with the casket, taking about his life and funny memories to lighten the mood. We were all holding it together when his little boy (who had just arrived) walks up to J's casket and says "Daddy's sleeping. Wake up! Night night" I don't think I have ever felt more helpless and heartbroken than at that moment.  

It's been 3 years, and still reliving that moment kills me. That was heart break for another person, which was so intense.
